purpose: Review the value of separate policy subjects, not sentence-by-sentence conformance.

subjects.subject: topic.architecture.composed-design-admission
subjects.reason: Evaluates whether the complete Engine design earns its permanent mechanisms.

subjects.subject: topic.architecture.authority-scope-admission
subjects.reason: Protects distinct owners of graph, policy, routing, and evidence semantics.

subjects.subject: topic.architecture.immutable-authority-closure
subjects.reason: Owns the actual immutable snapshot and cold-replay promise.

subjects.subject: core.simplicity-and-complection
subjects.reason: Keeps design review focused on independent concerns and the cost exposed to callers.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.per-commit-boundary
subjects.reason: Owns the actual staged publication and affected-check boundary.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.isolation-applicability
subjects.reason: Branch selection is useful workflow advice, but the Engine review scope can remain at publication and resource safety.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.branch-context
subjects.reason: Branch-context bookkeeping does not need a per-section completeness certificate.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.integration-mechanisms
subjects.reason: Generic Git integration guidance is broader than the Engine publication contract; review it as workflow guidance.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.cherry-pick-lineage
subjects.reason: Selective integration advice is not an Engine-supported cherry-pick operation requiring its own audit subject.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.terminal-branch-lifecycle
subjects.reason: Terminal classifications overlap resource-lifecycle review and add a second bookkeeping boundary.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.worktree-lifecycle
subjects.reason: Owns safe cleanup of real Git resources without losing uniquely reachable work.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.branch-history-review
subjects.reason: History review advice is outside the Engine publication operation; a certificate does not perform that review.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.hook-bypass-authority
subjects.reason: The Engine does not provide a hook-bypass operation. The safety guidance remains, without speculative conformance machinery.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.rewrite-authority
subjects.reason: The Engine does not expose history rewriting. Preserve the guidance; remove the unused audit subject.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.topology
subjects.reason: Topology advice is not a separate Engine guarantee; publication tests cover the real supported topology.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.commit-message
subjects.reason: Owns the actual commit artifact produced by Engine application.

subjects.subject: workflow.commit.invalid-outcomes
subjects.reason: Restates failures already owned by the preceding rules; no separate semantic subject is needed.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.declaration-and-semantic-authority
subjects.reason: Distinguishes the public declaration from delegated validation and domain semantics.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.version-scope-and-invalidation
subjects.reason: Controls meaningful compatibility and review invalidation boundaries.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.generated-semantic-conformance
subjects.reason: Owns actual generated models and public consumer behavior.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.schema-dialect-and-vocabulary
subjects.reason: Bounds supported schema behavior and explicit unsupported outcomes.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.identity-versus-instance-equality
subjects.reason: Prevents identity normalization from changing validation semantics.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.validation-proof-lifetime
subjects.reason: Owns when a validated value can be reused and when boundary validation is necessary.

subjects.subject: topic.contracts.invariant-contracts
subjects.reason: Connects observable invariants, enforcement ownership, and appropriate failures.

subjects.subject: topic.cross-platform.filesystem-paths
subjects.reason: Owns real path handling across valid repository paths and platforms.

subjects.subject: topic.dependencies.implementation-versus-dependency
subjects.reason: Controls the cost and correctness of reimplementing standardized semantics.

subjects.subject: topic.dependencies.requirement-and-ownership
subjects.reason: Owns real executable dependency declarations and reproducible environments.

subjects.subject: profile.boundary.generated-contract.applicability
subjects.reason: Owns the routing decision for actual generated program contracts.

subjects.subject: profile.boundary.generated-contract.semantic-closure
subjects.reason: Explicitly delegates to Contracts, Build, Verification, and Dependencies; a separate subject duplicates those owners.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.written-plan-applicability
subjects.reason: Keeps routine development free of unnecessary planning ceremony.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.artifact-model
subjects.reason: Directory layout is readable planning guidance; a separate certificate duplicates review of structured active-plan records.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.active-plan-fields
subjects.reason: Owns the structured plan records that the retained plan checker actually accepts.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.lifecycle
subjects.reason: Lifecycle guidance remains in Planning; a separate coverage certificate adds no independent Engine operation.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.plan-admission
subjects.reason: Admission ceremony does not need its own coverage certificate; planning applicability and actual record validation remain.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.concurrent-integration-routing
subjects.reason: Concurrent-work specialization remains routable through the module graph; no separate subject certificate is needed.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.repository-isolation
subjects.reason: Repeats Commit isolation guidance at the planning surface; retain the guidance without a second review subject.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.projection-completeness
subjects.reason: Owns coordinated standards, routing, graph, and consumer updates through the Engine.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.acceptance-claims
subjects.reason: Repeats the Verification-owned acceptance policy; one substantive owner is sufficient.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.milestones-and-slices
subjects.reason: Useful work-sizing advice, but no distinct Engine behavior requires a permanent per-section audit subject.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.current-state
subjects.reason: Document housekeeping does not justify its own recurring completeness certificate.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.replanning
subjects.reason: Replanning guidance is reviewed with the workflow; a per-section certificate adds no independent assurance.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.systemic-finding-replan
subjects.reason: Specializes replanning and design admission; retain the advice without another review obligation.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.findings
subjects.reason: Issue-record fields are process bookkeeping, not a separate Engine guarantee.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.concurrent-work
subjects.reason: Delegation guidance belongs in the workflow and does not need a separate certificate.

subjects.subject: workflow.planning.completion
subjects.reason: Completion bookkeeping duplicates actual acceptance evidence and plan validation.

subjects.subject: router.generated-contract-profile-applicability
subjects.reason: Duplicates applicability owned by the generated-contract profile; router behavior is tested directly.

subjects.subject: topic.security.filesystem-containment
subjects.reason: Protects filesystem authority for reading and applying standards.

subjects.subject: workflow.verification.acceptance-claims
subjects.reason: Owns whether retained verification earns its cost and proves the objective.

subjects.subject: workflow.verification.evidence-oracle-boundary
subjects.reason: Prevents structural agreement from being presented as semantic conformance.

subjects.subject: workflow.verification.negative-fixture-isolation
subjects.reason: A useful testing technique covered by the retained evidence-boundary policy; not a separate completeness subject.

subjects.subject: workflow.verification.differential-evidence
subjects.reason: Specializes the retained oracle boundary; do not certify the same oracle principle twice.
